compos.text: "Currently you don't have any timetable installed. After pressing the OK button a screen will appear which will allow you downloading timetable for selected cities."
Alt text: "Smartphone status bar showing multiple Facebook notifications, a clock icon, a lock icon, a battery icon, a Wi-Fi icon, and the current time displayed as 2:21."

compos.summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a notification message indicating that no timetable is currently installed. It informs the user that after pressing the "OK" button, a new screen will appear, allowing them to download timetables for selected cities. The message is presented in a white dialog box with an "OK" button at the bottom right. The background of the screen is grey, and there is a "Loading data..." message below the dialog box. The top of the screen shows the status bar with various icons, including social media notifications, battery status, and the current time (2:21).
